title: Only the read groups changed
prompt: An editor removes a group from a page's read groups. The page body and its updated timestamp do not change. How does your connector reflect this?

options.text: Wait for the next body edit to carry the new ACL.
options.feedback: The body may never change. Removed users keep access until it does.

options.text: Detect the ACL change on its own path, push it, and verify access flips after processing.
options.feedback: Right. Permissions and memberships are processed asynchronously, and permission changes need their own detection and schedule.

options.text: Nothing is needed; the source checks access at click time.
options.feedback: Snippets reach users and the model before any click.

takeaway: Permission changes are changes, even when the text is not.
